notes.title: Update v1.3
notes.content:
Update v1.3 introduces some changes to the UI, gameplay tweaks, and bug fixes.

[b]Changes to the UI[/b]

[list]
[*] The ability display is now visible within the upgrade menu, giving you an easier overview of the abilities you currently own.
[*] Centering the camera on the most recently activated input node (spawn point) now also pings the location of that node, making it easier to find.
[*] The most recently activated input nodes now have an occasional shimmer effect, with the aim of making them easier to identify.
[*] I've improved the upgrade menu display in 21:9 aspect ratio.
[/list]


[b]Gameplay adjustments[/b]

[list]
[*] Previously, if you had completed a chapter you wouldn't be shown the chapter complete screen again on all subsequent playthroughs. That has now been changed, so every chapter will show a chapter complete display offering the option to move on to the next chapter.
[*] The speed of new input nodes was a little too high in Chapters 2 and 5. That has now been slightly tuned down.
[/list]


[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] I've now fixed a problem with the input (spawning) nodes in Chapters 2 and 5 that were causing them to continue counting down to spawning while the game was paused and caused an issue with spawning deliveries even when the node had been deactivated.
[*] There was an issue that was causing more Pause abilities to be restored than you currently own (!), which I've now fixed.
[/list]


Thanks for playing Kaskade!

notes.title: Big update ahead of final release
notes.content:
The biggest change in this update is a complete re-work of how the shop functions in the game, shifting the shop closer to a roguelike upgrade system. 

The update also includes a meaningful performance improvement, tweaks to gameplay, and bug fixes. 

Thanks and have fun!

notes.title: February 18 Update
notes.content: This update implements a fairly significant change to the difficulty of the game. Speed controls have been reworked - specifically slow was replaced with a full pause, tuning down the difficulty of the game. To fit with the reworked speed controls, the lives system was also updated.

notes.title: Minor patch - 16 February
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Input nodes (aka spawners) can now jump and double jump
[*] Fixed bug with the credit display menu not fully updating when purchasing updates
[*] Fixed bug caused by deleting belts
[*] The reworked update menu Ui now ensures that the credit display is visible (if it was previously closed by the player)
[*] And many other small fixes :-)
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of life patch February 14 - Happy Valentines :-)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added support for key rebinding. 
[*] Added windowed / full screen options
[*] Small tweaks to the UI to better scale to windowed mode
[*] Mostly disabled the Unity Localization package, for now, as it is a major source of bugs
[*] Updated the Tutorial to provide more clarity  
[*] Many more small tweaks and bug fixes. 
[/list]
